description: Brings MIDI in from a hardware device on the computer and puts it onto vMIDI cables

outputs.text: Carries the channel messages arriving from the device: notes, controllers, program changes, pressure and pitch bend
Carries the system messages arriving from the device: timing clock, start, continue, stop, song position and the rest
Carries every message arriving from the device, channel and system alike

notes: nothing comes out of this module until a device is chosen from its right-click menu; the black strip at the top reads No Device until one is
menu: MIDI Driver - MIDI Input Device — chooses which of the computer's MIDI systems the device list below is drawn from
MIDI Inputs - Slot 1 — chooses the hardware MIDI input this module reads; None disconnects it again
